# hiok_virtual_network (Data Source)

Look up an existing virtual network by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hiok_virtual_network" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `address_space` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
